coordination_laws: An active owner chat may continue its assigned body without a parallel rebuild elsewhere.
JMlogic observes, reconciles, verifies and mounts; it does not seize an active lane merely because progress is imperfect.
A reported completion is not physical custody until exact files, hashes and receipts are seated.
A public route is not automatically a full source package.
A shaped standalone is not automatically the raw or canonical source.
A higher version number does not supersede missing behaviour or proof.
Frozen authorities are extended additively, not rebuilt from memory.
